test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement rod conclusions carefully, assuming that the information given in the statements is true even if it appears to be a variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

Statements: 

Every hospital has patients

Conclusions:

I. Patients are available only in hospitals.

II. Hospitals do not have patients.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either conclusion I or II follows.

solution:
Given,

Statement:

Every hospital has patients

Conclusions:

I. Patients are available only in hospitals - False (Because, the statement only specifies that hospitals have patients but does not state that patients can only be found in hospitals).

II. Hospitals do not have patients - False (Because, the statement explicitly states that every hospital has patients, which contradicts this conclusion).

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
